mentions.name: epanet-js
mentions.description: A local-first web application for simulating water networks that runs entirely in the browser, requires no login, and saves files locally to the user's device. It aims to replace clunky, expensive enterprise desktop simulation tools built on the open-source US EPA engine and is released under the Functional Source License.
mentions.problem: Enterprise desktop water network simulation tools are clunky and expensive, often charging $10k+ for wrapped versions of the open-source US EPA engine.
